name: rider-comms
description: Hands-free, proximity-based group voice + navigation app for moped/motorcycle riders

scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=shared && npm run test --workspace=backend && npm run test:client --workspace=mobile
scripts.lint: node --check docs/app.js && node --check docs/routes.js && node --check docs/sw.js && node --check scripts/build-pwa.mjs && node scripts/check-client-parity.mjs && node scripts/check-service-worker.mjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p shared/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p backend/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p mobile/tsconfig.json
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
